notes:
0.92.0: «👤 فلان جه؟» — the cashier on duty is asked about each colleague 5 minutes after his time (again every 5): «came» records his attendance, «not here» (reason + when) goes to the owner who approves or deducts, the automatic deduction waits; attendance by hand (time + hours) in the employee sheet and the day review; «مرتبي» up to the last check-in is now a setting (off by default).
0.91.0: an employee's «مرتبي» shows what he earned up to the last day he checked in; the month's expenses (this month or the previous one, both shops) with edit, delete and «add an expense on a past day»; deductions and additions on a past day; a fixed weekly day off per employee (picked from the bot, approved by the manager, deducted every week, swapped only with the colleague who has that day); the owner can give a manager the whole payroll (except his own pay).
0.90.1: the shift's debts card shows what is still unpaid; an account moved with its customer to another device is no longer shown as a debt.
0.90.0: fixes - the WiFi-cards link (both apps used the same port), one InstaPay screenshot per bill, a permission's start time, the day's InstaPay list in the daily report, the day's last close waits until every device and table is closed, and a closed table can't be paid twice.
0.89.2: WiFi - put an already printed card on a device or table by its code (checked with Wi-Code first).
0.89.1: Telegram - commands and buttons used inside a group topic now answer in the same topic instead of the private chat.
0.89.0: the owner / manager can fix or delete any sale of the month - a device's time, drinks, payment, device (repriced), discount and shift; a table; an expense; a debt and its collection; a booking's deposit; a cash-out - with a reason; the drawer, the shift, the reports and the stock follow; deleted ones are kept in a delete log and can be brought back. Also 0.87: WiFi cards and 0.85/0.86: the program is now called 1-Zone.
